name: limpid
description: Limpid — an educational writing coach for academic prose. Scores against good writing (Orwell, Strunk & White, Hemingway, the Economist) and teaches why.

limpid.audience.markdownDescription: Default target reader to judge audience-altitude against (e.g. `NeurIPS reviewer`, `ML newcomer`). Leave empty to let Limpid infer it; you can also change it per run in the panel.

limpid.anthropicApiKey.markdownDescription: Anthropic API key used **only** when Copilot's Language Model API is unavailable. Leave empty to use Copilot, or to run deterministic-only (no LLM).
